Name: Golden Walnut Framework
Author: ResoNight46
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]With this Framework mod, you can add custom Golden Walnuts and Parrot Upgrade Perches (The Parrots that sit on a stick that lets you change a part of the map if you give him Walnuts). For detailed instructions please read the [url=https://github.com/ResoNight/GoldenWalnutFramework]Author Guide[/url] on the github page.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install and unpack the mod and put it into the game's mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Provides a Framework so you can add new custom Golden Walnuts and Parrot Upgrade Perches.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod only requires SMAPI, but installing Content Patcher is strongly recommended. Secret Note Framework from Ichortower might also be useful if you want to add secret Notes.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]For Modders[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=2]To learn how to use this mod, you should read through the [url=https://github.com/ResoNight/GoldenWalnutFramework]Author Guide[/url] on the github page for this Mod.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Huge thanks to all the very helpful members in the Stardew Valley Discord server that answered my questions :)

Manifest.Name: Golden Walnut Framework
